name: BrewPage MCP
description: Publish HTML pages, Markdown, files, static sites, JSON and key-value data to BrewPage and get a shareable HTTPS link, then list, read, update, delete or change settings of your publications; free, no account or API key needed.
auth: None (anonymous); optional OAuth sign-in to a free BrewPage account
requirements: Free service; you set how long each publication stays; an optional free profile manages all publications in one place.
